findings.highlight: It was a night with a beautiful moon
findings.evidenceJa: それは、五年前の冬の話
findings.governingReading: That was a story from the winter five years ago
findings.explanation: The entire opening temporal frame is absent from English page0.

findings.evidenceJa: 縁側
findings.governingReading: the veranda
findings.explanation: The moon-viewing location is mistranslated.

findings.evidenceJa: のんびりとしている
findings.governingReading: spend his time resting quietly
findings.explanation: The dying Kiritsugu’s quiet withdrawal gains a judgment of carelessness.

findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方
findings.governingReading: ally of justice
findings.explanation: The central ethical term is replaced by a genre label in Kiritsugu’s deathbed memory.

findings.evidenceJa: 懐かしむように
findings.governingReading: as though remembering it nostalgically
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s reflective nostalgia becomes active yearning.

findings.evidenceJa: むっとして言い返す
findings.governingReading: I answer back in annoyance
findings.explanation: Child Shirou’s small offended reaction is strengthened.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠い月を仰いだ
findings.governingReading: looked up at the distant moon
findings.explanation: The shared moon and its distance disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 相づちをうつ切嗣
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu nods or murmurs agreement
findings.explanation: A small responsive gesture is generalized.

findings.highlight: I’ll make it come true. “I’ll make it come true.”
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が、ちゃんと形にしてやるから
findings.governingReading: I will properly give your dream form
findings.explanation: One active Japanese vow is duplicated in the English display.

findings.evidenceJa: 父は微笑った
findings.governingReading: my father smiled
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s quiet final smile becomes laughter.

findings.evidenceJa: 長く息を吸って
findings.governingReading: drawing a long breath
findings.explanation: The duration and finality of Kiritsugu’s breath are omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 幼い自分は騒ぎ立てなかった
findings.governingReading: my young self did not raise a commotion
findings.explanation: Absence of panic or commotion is narrowed to not crying, contradicting the tears described next.

findings.evidenceJa: 長い眠りに入った、父親だった人
findings.governingReading: the man who had been my father, now entered into a long sleep
findings.explanation: Death and the retrospective distance in “the person who had been my father” are softened.

findings.evidenceJa: その後はサッパリしたものだった
findings.governingReading: afterward I felt completely cleared out or refreshed
findings.explanation: Shirou’s strange emotional reset becomes an undefined absence.

findings.highlight: there was no time to be playing around
findings.evidenceJa: のんびりしている暇などありはしない
findings.governingReading: there was no time to take things easy
findings.explanation: Purposeful urgency is moralized as avoiding play.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識もなく、全身に火傷を負って死にかけていた子供
findings.governingReading: the unconscious child, burned over his entire body and near death
findings.explanation: The condition defining Shirou’s fire survival is almost entirely omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 目に涙をためるぐらい喜んで
findings.governingReading: was so overjoyed that tears gathered in his eyes
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s tearful joy at saving one person becomes invented dialogue thanking the victim.

findings.evidenceJa: 外に連れ出してくれた
findings.governingReading: lifted the child into his arms and carried him outside
findings.explanation: The completed physical rescue from the fire is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 誰も助けてくれなかった
findings.governingReading: no one came to anyone’s rescue
findings.explanation: The devastated scene-wide absence of rescuers is narrowed to Shirou personally.

findings.evidenceJa: 誰も助けてやれなかった
findings.governingReading: no one was able to save anyone else
findings.explanation: Collective helplessness is reassigned solely to Shirou.

findings.highlight: I was saved, and a person was there to save me
findings.evidenceJa: ただ一人助けられた自分と、ただ一人助けてくれた人
findings.governingReading: I alone was saved, and there was one person alone who saved me
findings.explanation: The mirrored uniqueness binding Shirou and Kiritsugu is weakened.

findings.highlight: leaving me his dream of becoming a superhero himself
findings.evidenceJa: “そういうモノ”に成りたかったと遺して
findings.governingReading: leaving behind the words that he had wanted to become such a person
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s final disclosure is turned into an explicit bequest of his dream to Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: 早く一人前になる方法
findings.governingReading: how to become fully fledged quickly
findings.explanation: Shirou’s urgency and concern with maturity are omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: みんなが幸せでいられればいい、なんて魔法みたいな夢
findings.governingReading: how to realize the magic-like dream that everyone might remain happy
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s habitual, knowingly impossible formulation is flattened.

findings.highlight: the blond-haired girl following me around
findings.evidenceJa: 一緒に付いてきた金髪の女の子
findings.governingReading: the blond girl who came along with me
findings.explanation: Saber’s arrival with Shirou becomes mildly dismissive trailing behavior.

findings.highlight: What, I’m in my own room?
findings.evidenceJa: 目を覚ますと見慣れた部屋にいた
findings.governingReading: when I awoke, I was in the familiar room
findings.explanation: The English inserts a full spoken realization absent from the Japanese.

findings.evidenceJa: 濁った血の味
findings.governingReading: the murky, stale taste of blood
findings.explanation: The blood’s foul quality is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: どろっとした空気が流れ込んできた
findings.governingReading: each breath draws in air made viscous by pooled blood
findings.explanation: The causal bodily horror becomes generic thick air.

findings.highlight: Imagining that gives me a headache
findings.evidenceJa: 熱でてきた
findings.governingReading: that image is making me feel feverishly hot
findings.explanation: A heat sensation is mistranslated as head pain.

findings.evidenceJa: 体は栄養を欲している
findings.governingReading: my body is demanding nutrition
findings.explanation: A physiological need is generalized.

findings.highlight: training that could have caused this pain
findings.evidenceJa: 体中が筋肉痛になるような鍛錬
findings.governingReading: training severe enough to leave every muscle in my body aching
findings.explanation: The extent and nature of Shirou’s bodily pain disappear.

findings.highlight: Yeah, that’s why I’m even more surprised
findings.evidenceJa: まるでこっちがお客さまなのでは、と勘違いさせられるほど
findings.governingReading: enough to make me mistake myself for the guest
findings.explanation: The English adds a separate explanatory reaction absent from the Japanese.

findings.evidenceJa: 朝の空気に浸っている
findings.governingReading: why am I lingering immersed in the morning atmosphere
findings.explanation: A concrete lapse into normality becomes a generic mental state.

findings.evidenceJa: 腹を斬り捨てられた
findings.governingReading: Berserker cut away my abdomen
findings.explanation: A blade injury and body region are changed to an explosion involving an organ.

findings.highlight: the feeling of having a hole in my body
findings.evidenceJa: 体がぽっかりとなくなった感覚
findings.governingReading: the sensation that a whole part of my body had simply vanished
findings.explanation: Massive bodily absence is reduced to a hole.

findings.highlight: Something in my stomach moves. It makes me feel sick. It makes me feel sick, but that proves I’m still alive.
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き気が戻ってくる
findings.governingReading: the nausea returns
findings.explanation: The English inserts three sentences of internal movement and survival interpretation absent from the Japanese.

findings.evidenceJa: なんかカチンときた
findings.governingReading: something in me snaps with irritation
findings.explanation: Shirou’s own sudden reaction becomes a judgment that Tohsaka is annoying.

findings.evidenceJa: バカじゃないぞ、と視線で抗議する
findings.governingReading: I protest with a look insisting I am not an idiot
findings.explanation: A defensive comic look becomes a hostile glare and loses its message.

findings.evidenceJa: これ見よがしに疲れた溜息
findings.governingReading: an ostentatiously weary sigh meant for me to notice
findings.explanation: Rin’s deliberately performative exasperation is omitted.

findings.highlight: It’s not that I protected her with my life
findings.evidenceJa: 庇った訳じゃない
findings.governingReading: I was not trying to shield her
findings.explanation: Shirou denies the act category itself; the English only denies a more extreme manner.

findings.highlight: it just happened to work out like that
findings.evidenceJa: ああなっちまっただけ
findings.governingReading: it merely ended up that way
findings.explanation: A disastrous bodily outcome is described with the positive idiom “worked out.”

findings.evidenceJa: ますます不機嫌になっていく
findings.governingReading: Rin grows increasingly displeased
findings.explanation: Rin’s anger is infantilized as sulking.

findings.evidenceJa: 最後までやり過ごせるかも
findings.governingReading: you might manage to stay out of it and survive until the end
findings.explanation: Rin’s intended endpoint and passive survival strategy are weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 心配してくれた
findings.governingReading: she worried about me
findings.explanation: The completed night of worry becomes a present ongoing state.

findings.evidenceJa: もっと頭のいい行動をして
findings.governingReading: act more intelligently next time
findings.explanation: Rin’s demand for better judgment becomes only sequencing thought before action.

findings.evidenceJa: ぷい、と視線を逸らす遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka sharply turns her gaze aside
findings.explanation: The pointed physical manner of Rin’s reaction is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 仕草そのものは刺々しい
findings.governingReading: the gesture itself remains prickly
findings.explanation: Rin’s outward hostility becomes briskness.

findings.evidenceJa: そのスッパリさ加減
findings.governingReading: the abrupt cleanness with which she changes subjects
findings.explanation: Rin’s sharp compartmentalization becomes a personality judgment about honesty.

findings.evidenceJa: 聞かない訳にもいかない
findings.governingReading: I cannot very well avoid asking
findings.explanation: Practical necessity becomes Shirou calling silence stupid.

findings.evidenceJa: まともに頭が働く
findings.governingReading: your head is working properly after all
findings.explanation: Rin’s barbed acknowledgment of one sound decision becomes general praise of intelligence.

findings.evidenceJa: 外見は元通りになった
findings.governingReading: his outward appearance had returned to normal
findings.explanation: Full visible restoration is weakened to seeming fine.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方一人で生ききった
findings.governingReading: you made it all the way through alive by yourself
findings.explanation: The emphatic completeness of Shirou’s self-sustained survival is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 完治させた
findings.governingReading: healed that wound completely
findings.explanation: Complete restoration is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: ぶっ飛んだ中身をどうにかした
findings.governingReading: somehow restored his own insides after they had been blown away
findings.explanation: Rin’s graphic account of missing internal tissue becomes generic wounds.

findings.evidenceJa: 治療の魔術
findings.governingReading: healing Magecraft
findings.explanation: The work’s technical category Magecraft is generalized to magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 蘇生
findings.governingReading: resurrection
findings.explanation: A result or feat is unnecessarily reclassified as a type of magic.

findings.highlight: a normal relationship like the one between a normal master and their familiar
findings.evidenceJa: 普通の主人と使い魔の関係
findings.governingReading: the ordinary relationship between master and familiar
findings.explanation: The English repeats “normal” and becomes clumsy.

findings.highlight: the magus’s power flows into the familiar
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師の能力が使い魔に付与される
findings.governingReading: the magus’s abilities are bestowed upon the familiar
findings.explanation: Granting an ability becomes an energy-flow mechanism.

findings.highlight: the familiar’s power is flowing into you and helping you out
findings.evidenceJa: 使い魔の特殊能力が主人を助けてる
findings.governingReading: the familiar’s special ability is helping its master
findings.explanation: The special ability itself becomes an unspecified quantity of power flowing into Shirou.

findings.highlight: go against Berserker with her small size
findings.evidenceJa: あの体格でバーサーカーとまともに打ち合う
findings.governingReading: trade direct blows with Berserker despite that slight build
findings.explanation: Saber’s physique and direct clash are generalized.

findings.highlight: doesn’t listen to much of what I say
findings.evidenceJa: ぜんっぜん聞かない
findings.governingReading: does not listen to a single thing I say
findings.explanation: Rin’s emphatic comic complaint is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: あっちがそれを食べるだけ
findings.governingReading: the Servant simply consumes or eats that energy
findings.explanation: Rin’s fuel-consumption metaphor is flattened.

findings.highlight: shared their physical bodies with their Servants
findings.evidenceJa: 肉体面でもサーヴァントと共融して
findings.governingReading: physically co-fused with their Servants
findings.explanation: A technical bodily fusion is changed into the vague idea of sharing bodies.

findings.evidenceJa: 擬似的な“不死”
findings.governingReading: pseudo-“immortality”
findings.explanation: A derivative functional state becomes a false claim.

findings.evidenceJa: 多少の傷
findings.governingReading: minor wounds
findings.explanation: The healing range is greatly expanded.

findings.highlight: the cause is in Saber’s materialization
findings.evidenceJa: 原因がセイバーの実体化にある
findings.governingReading: the cause is Saber’s materialization
findings.explanation: The causal statement is rendered as though the cause were located inside an event.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしが悩む必要はなかった
findings.governingReading: I would not have needed to struggle over this
findings.explanation: Rin’s counterfactual reference to a prior problem becomes present reassurance.

findings.evidenceJa: まず助からない筈
findings.governingReading: you would almost certainly not survive
findings.explanation: Rin’s strongly qualified prediction becomes certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 多少の傷なら治る
findings.governingReading: minor wounds will heal
findings.explanation: The dangerous belief Rin rejects is expanded from minor healing to surviving any major injury.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーから何かを貰ってる
findings.governingReading: receiving something from Saber
findings.explanation: An involuntary transfer from Saber becomes her intentional assistance.

findings.highlight: you’re not just using Saber’s magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 減るのはセイバーの魔力だけじゃない
findings.governingReading: it is not only Saber’s magical energy that decreases
findings.explanation: Resource depletion is changed into Shirou’s active use.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術ってのは金食い虫
findings.governingReading: Magecraft is a devourer of money
findings.explanation: The technical category and comic money-eating image are weakened.

findings.highlight: I won’t allow myself to be wrong
findings.evidenceJa: そうでなければ許さないんだから、とくにわたしが
findings.governingReading: I will not accept it being otherwise, least of all in my own case
findings.explanation: Rin’s grievance about Magecraft’s expense becomes concern with being factually wrong.

findings.evidenceJa: 次は真面目な話
findings.governingReading: next comes the serious subject
findings.explanation: The promised discussion topic becomes one question.

findings.highlight: I haven’t made my mind up yet
findings.evidenceJa: ただ考えがおよばない
findings.governingReading: I simply have not managed to think that far
findings.explanation: Failure to conceive a plan becomes indecision among known options.

findings.highlight: I should fight for the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を競い合う
findings.governingReading: compete for the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: Description of the contest becomes a normative instruction.

findings.highlight: I want to try to avoid killing people
findings.evidenceJa: 殺し合いは出来れば避けたい
findings.governingReading: I would prefer to avoid killing one another
findings.explanation: The reciprocal lethal conflict is narrowed to Shirou killing others.

findings.highlight: I’m not too sure about risking my life for something I don’t want
findings.evidenceJa: 欲しくないモノの為に命を張るのは、どうかと思う
findings.governingReading: staking my life for something I do not want seems fundamentally wrong
findings.explanation: Shirou’s objection is weakened to uncertainty.

findings.highlight: risk their life for their Master
findings.evidenceJa: 時にマスターの為に命を落とす
findings.governingReading: sometimes lose their lives for their Masters
findings.explanation: Actual death is softened to taking a risk.

findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターを消しにかかる
findings.governingReading: move to eliminate other Masters
findings.explanation: The targets of Servant aggression are reversed, breaking the following Command Spell logic.

findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターを無力化する
findings.governingReading: render other Masters powerless
findings.explanation: General neutralization is narrowed to removing weapons.

findings.highlight: allowing your Servant to try to kill other Servants
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントとサーヴァントを殺し合わせる
findings.governingReading: making Servants kill one another
findings.explanation: The Masters’ structural responsibility for reciprocal killing is weakened.

findings.highlight: if I reached a compromise with other Masters
findings.evidenceJa: お互いに聖杯を諦めれば
findings.governingReading: if we reconciled and both gave up the Grail
findings.explanation: The necessary shared renunciation is omitted.

findings.highlight: ready to kill or be killed
findings.evidenceJa: 殺し、殺される立場
findings.governingReading: placed in the position of killing and being killed
findings.explanation: An imposed structural role becomes Saber’s willingness.

findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントは絶命しても
findings.governingReading: even when a Servant dies
findings.explanation: Death is euphemized as elimination in the very argument over whether it counts as death.

findings.evidenceJa: もう死んでも死なない現象
findings.governingReading: a phenomenon already dead and therefore unable to die again
findings.explanation: Rin’s paradoxical ontological explanation is flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: 人の姿をしたモノが息絶える
findings.governingReading: a being in human form ceases breathing and dies
findings.explanation: Shirou’s focus on witnessed embodied death is converted into disappearance.

findings.highlight: carrying such a sense of justice
findings.evidenceJa: 正義感振り回してる
findings.governingReading: brandishing that sense of justice
findings.explanation: Rin’s accusation of obtrusive moralism is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 相手を殺すための戦い
findings.governingReading: a battle whose purpose is to kill the opponent
findings.explanation: Purposeful killing is changed to reciprocal mortal stakes.

findings.highlight: I don’t have any intention of killing others
findings.evidenceJa: 自分から殺し合いをする気はない
findings.governingReading: I have no intention of initiating a fight to the death
findings.explanation: Shirou’s refusal to initiate reciprocal combat becomes a blanket refusal to kill.

findings.highlight: this town could be in ruins in just one night
findings.evidenceJa: 町なんて一晩で壊滅する
findings.governingReading: the town could be annihilated in a single night
findings.explanation: Total destruction is weakened.

findings.highlight: Humans can’t see those in spirit form
findings.evidenceJa: 霊感のない人間には姿さえ観測できない
findings.governingReading: humans without spiritual sensitivity cannot even perceive their form
findings.explanation: The limitation to spiritually insensitive observers is omitted, making invisibility universal.

findings.highlight: Servants can affect the real world as spirits
findings.evidenceJa: 実体を持つかのように現世に干渉できる
findings.governingReading: they can interfere with the material world as though possessing physical bodies
findings.explanation: The paradox enabling Servants to act like physical beings while spiritual is omitted.

findings.highlight: more than just an unfair game
findings.evidenceJa: ワンサイドゲームどころの話じゃない
findings.governingReading: This is beyond even being a one-sided game
findings.explanation: The overwhelming asymmetry is weakened into generic unfairness.

findings.highlight: like natural death for normal people
findings.evidenceJa: 一般人から見れば自然災害のようなもの
findings.governingReading: to ordinary people, it is like a natural disaster
findings.explanation: A Servant attack’s apparent status as an uncontrollable calamity is mistranslated as natural death.

findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターしか襲わないんじゃないのか
findings.governingReading: aren’t Masters and Servants supposed to attack only other Masters?
findings.explanation: The exclusive target restriction becomes an awkward question that can suggest the opposite.

findings.highlight: Don’t other people have nothing to do with them?
findings.evidenceJa: 町の人たちは無関係だろう
findings.governingReading: the people of the town have nothing to do with this
findings.explanation: A direct assertion that townspeople are uninvolved becomes an incoherent double negative.

findings.highlight: the more they can use the powers they had in life
findings.evidenceJa: 生前の特殊能力を自由に行使できる
findings.governingReading: can more freely exercise the special abilities they possessed in life
findings.explanation: The English drops both the special nature of the abilities and the freedom with which greater reserves permit their use.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術を連発できる
findings.governingReading: can use Magecraft repeatedly
findings.explanation: The technical category Magecraft is replaced with generic magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 巨大な弾を撃ち放つ
findings.governingReading: fire an enormous projectile
findings.explanation: The cannon metaphor’s enormous scale is reduced to a merely large bullet.

findings.highlight: They act with the magical energy inside them
findings.evidenceJa: 基本的に、彼らは自分の中だけの魔力で活動する
findings.governingReading: as a basic rule, they operate only on the magical energy within themselves
findings.explanation: The qualification and exclusivity of the Servants’ normal energy economy are omitted.

findings.highlight: can only use their powers using their own magical energy plus the magical energy of their Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の魔力プラス、主であるマスターの魔力分しか生前の力を発揮できない
findings.governingReading: can manifest only as much of their former power as their own magical energy plus their Master’s supply permits
findings.explanation: A quantitative limit on manifested former power is blurred into the energy with which they use unspecified powers.

findings.highlight: would be no match for other Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 優れたマスターには敵わない
findings.governingReading: could not compete with a superior Master
findings.explanation: The relevant comparison with a more capable Master is generalized to all other Masters.

findings.highlight: Usually, they replenish enough magical energy from their Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯に補助されたマスターからの提供だけで、大抵は事足りる
findings.governingReading: Usually the supply from a Master, assisted by the Grail, is enough
findings.explanation: The Grail’s support of ordinary Master-to-Servant energy supply disappears.

findings.highlight: one gets more magical energy from many people than from just one person
findings.evidenceJa: 一人より大勢の方が大量摂取できる
findings.governingReading: a crowd permits a much larger intake than one person
findings.explanation: The emphasis on mass intake is reduced to the truism that many provide more than one.

findings.evidenceJa: 人間の原感情や魂
findings.governingReading: human primal emotions and souls
findings.explanation: The specific claim that Servants convert primal emotions is generalized to emotions of any kind.

findings.evidenceJa: 人を殺しまくる
findings.governingReading: go on killing people indiscriminately
findings.explanation: The repeated, rampant character of the hypothetical killing is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 能力値以上の貯蔵はできない
findings.governingReading: cannot store more than their ability value permits
findings.explanation: A stat-defined storage ceiling is restated as a circular generic capacity limit.

findings.evidenceJa: 能力値以上の貯蔵はできない
findings.governingReading: They cannot store magical energy beyond their ability-value limit
findings.explanation: The classic branch uses an unclear pronoun with no stable local antecedent, damaging Rin’s technical explanation.

findings.highlight: other Masters might figure out your Servant’s abilities and identify them
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントの能力と正体が、他のマスターたちにバレかねない
findings.governingReading: other Masters may infer the Servant’s abilities and true identity
findings.explanation: The Servant is singular, but the English’s plural pronoun makes the identity clause grammatically and referentially unstable.

findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントを出し惜しみする筈
findings.governingReading: hold their Servants back rather than reveal them freely
findings.explanation: Strategic reluctance to commit and expose a Servant is weakened into vague sparing use.

findings.highlight: becoming heroes just because they were mass murderers
findings.evidenceJa: 暴虐者だからこそ英雄になった
findings.governingReading: becoming heroes precisely because they were tyrants or perpetrators of violent oppression
findings.explanation: The mature branch narrows violent tyranny to mass murder and treats the causal paradox as incidental.

findings.evidenceJa: 嫌味でも皮肉でもなく
findings.governingReading: neither spite nor irony
findings.explanation: Two excluded modes of barbed speech are collapsed into a single approximate category.

findings.highlight: a bit of strain in her personality
findings.evidenceJa: かすかな性格の歪み
findings.governingReading: a faint distortion in her personality
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic diagnosis of a warped personality becomes an unexplained strain.

findings.highlight: Since you don’t want to kill people, you’re just going to watch
findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターが何をしようが傍観する
findings.governingReading: stand by regardless of what the other Masters do
findings.explanation: Rin’s pointed accusation about allowing other Masters’ conduct is generalized and its unrestricted scope disappears.

findings.highlight: She really has a bad personality
findings.evidenceJa: かすかじゃなくてはっきりと性格が歪曲してる
findings.governingReading: her personality is warped not faintly but unmistakably
findings.explanation: The punchline’s explicit correction from a faint distortion to an obvious one is flattened.

findings.highlight: you won’t go out and kill other Masters, but you also say you’ll kill them if they do anything bad
findings.evidenceJa: 自分からマスターは倒さない、けど他のマスターが悪事を働いたら倒す
findings.governingReading: you will not defeat Masters proactively, but will defeat them if they commit wrongdoing
findings.explanation: Both occurrences of defeating a Master are changed to killing one, falsely making Shirou articulate a lethal policy.

findings.highlight: I can’t think of any other choices
findings.evidenceJa: それ以外の方針は考えつかない
findings.governingReading: I cannot devise any other policy
findings.explanation: A settled rule of conduct is reduced to a lack of alternative choices.

findings.highlight: as a man, I have to listen
findings.evidenceJa: 男が断言した以上、聞かない訳にもいかない
findings.governingReading: having made a firm declaration as a man, I cannot refuse to hear her out
findings.explanation: The obligation created by Shirou’s preceding declaration becomes a generic claim that men must listen.

findings.highlight: The girl who was talking about killing you and me
findings.evidenceJa: 簡単に殺せ、とか言ってた子
findings.governingReading: the girl who was saying to kill you and me with ease
findings.explanation: Illya’s casual expectation that Berserker can kill them easily is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 帰り道、問答無用で襲いかかってきた相手
findings.governingReading: the opponent who attacked us on the way home without question or parley
findings.explanation: The singular opponent is made plural and the refusal of any exchange is generalized into mercilessness.

findings.evidenceJa: アレは撃退できない
findings.governingReading: you cannot repel him
findings.explanation: Rin says Shirou cannot drive Berserker off; the English changes this into an undefined comparison of ability.

findings.evidenceJa: 悪かったな
findings.governingReading: well, excuse me
findings.explanation: Shirou’s irritated sarcastic retort is rendered as a sincere apology.

findings.highlight: The wound on my stomach is healed now
findings.evidenceJa: 今は塞がっている腹の傷
findings.governingReading: the abdominal wound has closed for now
findings.explanation: The visible closure of the wound is promoted to complete healing.

findings.highlight: It was pretty much instant death
findings.evidenceJa: 即死に近い大剣の跡
findings.governingReading: the greatsword’s mark, nearly instant death
findings.explanation: The concrete greatsword trace left on Shirou’s body is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 逃れようのない吐き気が戻ってくる
findings.governingReading: inescapable nausea returns
findings.explanation: The bodily reaction’s inescapability is removed.

findings.highlight: But what are you trying to say? I don’t quite understand
findings.evidenceJa: けど遠坂。おまえ、さっきから何を言いたいんだよ。ちょっと理解不能だぞ
findings.governingReading: But Tohsaka—what have you been trying to say? You’re making no sense
findings.explanation: Shirou’s direct address and sharper accusation that Rin is incomprehensible are softened.

findings.highlight: he should still be about half as useful
findings.evidenceJa: 半人前ぐらいの活躍はできる筈
findings.governingReading: he should still be capable of performing at roughly half strength
findings.explanation: Rin estimates Archer’s level of effective activity; the English evaluates his usefulness as a person or asset.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺、そこまで半人前なんかじゃないぞ
findings.governingReading: I am not that much of a novice
findings.explanation: Shirou denies being so incomplete or inexperienced, not merely being bad.

findings.evidenceJa: 三回も殺されかける
findings.governingReading: nearly be killed three times
findings.explanation: The repeated presence of attackers is erased by recasting attempted killing as near-death.

findings.evidenceJa: 右も左も分からない俺
findings.governingReading: for someone like me who does not know which way to turn
findings.explanation: Shirou’s situational lack of bearings is totalized into knowing nothing.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka would be a useful teacher
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は頼りになる先輩だ
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka is a dependable senior
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition of Rin as a reliable senior is narrowed to instrumental usefulness as a teacher.
